answer: Identities earn voting weight only through a proof-of-time ramp: weight starts at 1 and rises by 1 per epoch up to 20, and any gap resets it. Each extra account needs its own stake of 100 POA locked for 30 epochs, so a fleet's capital grows linearly while the delta between honest and fake weight stays small. An atlas of staking records and a ridge of audit checkpoints let validators replay and verify every lock.
